title: A spur gear pair
statement: A standard full-depth spur gear pair of module $m = 2\ \text{mm}$ has $N_1 = 18$ teeth on the driver and $N_2 = 36$ on the driven gear, at the pressure angle $\phi = 20°$ and $12\ \text{mm}$ wide. Find the pitch diameters, the centre distance, the speed ratio, the base diameters and the contact ratio.

artefact.caption: The gear pair: diameters, centre distance, speed ratio and contact ratio

steps.title: Pitch circles and centre distance
steps.note: A gear's pitch diameter is $d = mN$, so $d_1 = 2 \times 18 = 36\ \text{mm}$ and $d_2 = 2 \times 36 = 72\ \text{mm}$. The pitch circles touch on the line of centres: $a = \frac{d_1 + d_2}{2} = 54\ \text{mm}$.

steps.title: Speed ratio
steps.note: The pitch circles roll without slipping, so the speeds are inversely as the teeth: $i = \frac{N_2}{N_1} = \frac{36}{18} = 2$. The driven gear turns once for two turns of the driver, the other way.

steps.title: Base circles
steps.note: The involute is unwound from the base circle, $d_b = d\cos\phi$: $d_{b1} = 36\cos 20° = 33.83\ \text{mm}$ and $d_{b2} = 72\cos 20° = 67.66\ \text{mm}$.

steps.title: Contact ratio
steps.note: The path of contact along the line of action is $Z = \sqrt{r_{a1}^2 - r_{b1}^2} + \sqrt{r_{a2}^2 - r_{b2}^2} - a\sin\phi$, with the tip radii $r_a = \frac{d}{2} + m$, that is $20\ \text{mm}$ and $38\ \text{mm}$, and the base radii $16.91\ \text{mm}$ and $33.83\ \text{mm}$. So $Z = 10.67 + 17.31 - 18.47 = 9.51\ \text{mm}$. Over the base pitch $p_b = \pi m\cos\phi = 5.904\ \text{mm}$ it is $\varepsilon = \frac{Z}{p_b} = 1.611$: always at least one pair of teeth in contact, and two for $61\ \%$ of the turn.

derived: $61\ \%$ of the turn in two-tooth contact
